branches.suggestion: Atchoo! Oh, I feel awful. My nose is running and my throat is sore.
branches.suggestionFa: هاپچه! آه، حالم افتضاحه. آبریزش بینی دارم و گلوم درد می‌کنه.

r2.speaker: mehdi
r2.text: Bless you! You've got a cold.

branches.suggestion: But I've got thirty children waiting for me! Should I go to school?
branches.suggestionFa: ولی سی تا بچه منتظرمن! برم مدرسه؟

r3.speaker: mehdi
r3.text: No, you shouldn't. Stay at home.

branches.suggestion: A little bit. Thirty-seven point eight. But the Year 4s have a test today!
branches.suggestionFa: یه کم. سی و هفت و هشت دهم. ولی کلاس چهارمی‌ها امروز امتحان دارن!

branches.suggestion: You're right. I'll call in sick. I hate it, though. I feel so guilty!
branches.suggestionFa: راست میگی. زنگ می‌زنم مرخصی استعلاجی می‌گیرم. ولی ازش متنفرم. خیلی عذاب وجدان دارم!

branches.suggestion: True. And I shouldn't give my cold to the kids. What should I do now?
branches.suggestionFa: درسته. و نباید سرماخوردگیم را به بچه‌ها بدم. حالا چی کار کنم؟

r6.speaker: mehdi
r6.text: You should go back to bed.

branches.suggestion: Bed sounds lovely. But who takes Nicola to school? Tom's on the early shift.
branches.suggestionFa: تخت عالیه. ولی کی نیکولا را می‌بره مدرسه؟ تام شیفت صبحه.

branches.suggestion: You're an angel! Her book bag is by the door. And don't come too close — you'll get ill too!
branches.suggestionFa: فرشته‌ای! کیف کتابش کنار دره. و خیلی نزدیک نیا — تو هم مریض میشی!
